title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
hints: Cut the list at its middle. At least one of the two halves is still sorted. How can you tell which?

Binary search with `lo`, `hi`, `mid`. If `nums[lo] <= nums[mid]`, the left half is sorted: go left exactly when `nums[lo] <= target < nums[mid]`. Otherwise the right half is sorted: go right exactly when `nums[mid] < target <= nums[hi]`.

Parallel example: in a sorted bookshelf that someone cut and swapped around, open the middle; one side is still in order, and checking whether your book's title falls inside that side's range tells you which side to search.
